rca_of_issue: Original bug (iter 11): useState initialisers in txn/[id].tsx read `existing?.field` synchronously at mount, but useTxns() loads AsyncStorage async so `existing` was undefined at first render — the fields never re-populated because useState only runs its initialiser once. The prior useEffect only re-synced `type`/`status`. Iter 12 fix: expanded that useEffect to setCurrency/setCurrencyAmount/setPurchaseRate/setExchangeRate/setTransferRate/setGoldUnit/setGoldAmount/setGoldPurchaseThb/setGoldCostInr/setGoldSaleInr/setTripId/setNotes as well, keyed on `existing?.id`. Verified visually and via input_value assertions on the actual preview URL — all 5 currency fields, trip picker, notes, and profit card render correctly on TXN-001 edit; status cycler + save now persist without wiping the record.
